_comment: Pre-registered strategy-label objective. Frozen 2026-10-30 before any benchmark run. Do not tune on test results; report sensitivity instead.
quality_metric: exact-file recall vs deleted ground truth (SHA-256)
model_selection: highest validation balanced accuracy; ties -> smaller depth, then larger min_samples_leaf; final model refit on train+val
primary_comparison: per-test-image median end-to-end time and recall, CART vs each baseline (paired, Wilcoxon signed-rank, two-sided)
acceptable_quality: per-image recall within 0.05 of the best fixed strategy on that image
